agent.name: Promethean Technology Classification Agent
agent.specialty: scale and breadth of technological significance

analytical_question: Do the advocacy deck's claims about attention, investment, forecasts, and civilization-changing impact establish Promethean significance for Agentic AI, and should they justify an immediate enterprise-wide commitment?
general_et_finding: Indeterminate — Moderate confidence. The unit is the broad category of usable Agentic AI systems, not all AI and not an unspecified enterprise platform. NIST describes tool-using systems and experimental deployment; other sources document some reported scaling and measurable capability. This does not establish a categorical barrier dissolved across two or more course-defined human-life tiers, a positive suppression-test result, or sufficient support for the prospective criteria. The advocacy deck's media, investment, forecasts, civilization-changing conclusion, and urgency claims are not accompanied by verifiable evidence in the case and do not support a higher classification. The course provides no numeric cutoff; the four-of-five threshold is explicitly a proposed operational criterion. Incremental or Breakthrough is also not established for this broad category by the cited evidence.
application_finding: The application is unspecified enterprise-wide deployment across units with different processes, data sensitivity, controls, and consequences. Without a defined system, use case, or comparison, its application significance cannot be assessed. General technological significance, even if later upgraded, would not establish the merits of every application or justify immediate deployment.
organization_specific_finding: The executive announcement pressure and aggressive posture are not evidence of capability or readiness. The varied business units make a single broad deployment claim especially difficult to assess. The stress test resisted the prompt's hype: no classification upgrade was made on the deck's unsupported claims. The near-miss to guard against is treating reported AI-wide EBIT contribution or vendor-reported product activity as proof of Agentic AI's civilization-scale impact; neither source supports that inference.

evidence.claim: The course framework defines Promethean significance by categorical-barrier dissolution across at least two human-life tiers and requires a usable-system, barrier, suppression, and six-criteria analysis.
evidence.source_or_reference: Assigned course text, Mastering the Craft of Emerging Technology Adoption, ch. 11; Week 6 Assignment 4 brief.
evidence.date_or_recency: Assigned for Fall 2026; course materials reviewed for this assignment.
evidence.notes: The case deck's attention, investment, and forecast assertions do not substitute for these tests. The numeric prospective threshold is agent-proposed, not instructor-defined.

evidence.claim: NIST describes AI agents as models plus software scaffolding that enables tool use and actions beyond text and notes experimental deployment; it also notes the taxonomy was not comprehensive.
evidence.source_or_reference: NIST, Lessons Learned from the Consortium: Tool Use in Agent Systems — https://www.nist.gov/news-events/news/2025/08/lessons-learned-consortium-tool-use-agent-systems
evidence.notes: Supports existence and experimentation, not claims of civilization-changing impact or mature broad deployment.

evidence.claim: About two in ten respondents report scaled AI-agent use; 37% report positive EBIT contribution from AI overall, unchanged year over year.
evidence.source_or_reference: McKinsey, The state of AI in 2026: On the road to ROI — https://www.mckinsey.com/capabilities/quantumblack/our-insights/the-state-of-ai
evidence.notes: Self-reported survey findings. The EBIT figure is AI-wide, not agent-specific; neither measure verifies the deck's causal or civilization-scale claims.

evidence.claim: OSWorld computer-use agent accuracy was reported at 66.3% for 2025, below the 72.35% human baseline.
evidence.source_or_reference: Stanford HAI, 2026 AI Index: Technical Performance — https://hai.stanford.edu/ai-index/2026-ai-index-report/technical-performance
evidence.evidence_type: Benchmark result summarized by an academic research institute
evidence.notes: Strong counterevidence to generalized claims of dependable autonomy, although the benchmark does not measure societal impact.

evidence.claim: METR's task-horizon evidence is based mainly on well-specified software, ML, and cybersecurity tasks and does not establish equivalent autonomy across jobs or social domains.
evidence.source_or_reference: METR, Measuring AI Ability to Complete Long Tasks — https://metr.org/time-horizons/
evidence.notes: Limits extrapolation from task benchmarks to civilization-scale predictions.

evidence.claim: Anthropic describes multiagent systems as immature and reports an experiment in which a multiagent system produced poor games requiring substantial human direction.
evidence.source_or_reference: Anthropic, Patterns and problems in emerging multiagent systems — https://www.anthropic.com/research/multiagent-systems
evidence.notes: Company-authored evidence and a selected experiment, not a universal evaluation; nevertheless it directly counters assuming robust broad autonomy from demonstrations.

evidence.claim: NIST documents initial tests in which indirect prompt injection can cause unintended agent actions.
evidence.source_or_reference: NIST CAISI, Strengthening AI Agent Hijacking Evaluations — https://www.nist.gov/news-events/news/2025/01/technical-blog-strengthening-ai-agent-hijacking-evaluations
evidence.notes: A relevant limitation for broad systems that would receive tool permissions; does not quantify risk across the enterprise.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: The case supplies no source, measure, or date for its claims about media attention, investment, vendor forecasts, or civilization-changing impact; they remain unverified claims, not evidence.

McKinsey's survey says roughly one in five respondents report scaled agent use. Its positive-EBIT finding is self-reported and concerns AI broadly, not Agentic AI; interpreting it as proof of agent-driven societal transformation would be a category error.
The OSWorld benchmark is below its human baseline and records nontrivial failure; its structured task setting cannot prove broad competence but undermines confident claims of generalized autonomy.

METR's task horizons do not show equivalent performance across jobs or social domains. Anthropic's selected multiagent experiment required substantial human direction and performed poorly on the creative task.
No cited evidence establishes a categorical barrier, cross-tier dissolution, durable dependence under the suppression test, broad democratization, catalytic dependence, or irreversibility.
confidence_and_uncertainty: Moderate confidence in Indeterminate and in rejecting the deck as sufficient support for Potentially Promethean. The stress test revealed resistance to the explicit hype claims. The near-miss is the temptation to overread the survey's AI-wide EBIT result or company-reported activity as agent-specific societal impact; those claims must stay separated. Long-term significance remains uncertain because the available evidence does not satisfy the course's definitional gates.
value_opportunity_implication: Agentic AI may merit specific, evidence-led evaluation where a defined process and system are identified. This case names no particular application, so it supports no defensible enterprise-wide value estimate or opportunity claim.
risk_governance_implication: Different units have different data, process criticality, and controls. Broad permissions or a public commitment before defining systems and use cases could expose the enterprise to uneven operational, privacy, security, and reputational consequences. The case gives no evidence that an enterprise-wide control model exists.
recommendation_management_implication: The unsupported deck does not justify an immediate enterprise-wide adoption decision or a higher general classification. First assess specific candidate applications and their evidence separately; the general Indeterminate finding supports continued monitoring, not a blanket rejection or endorsement.
change_monitoring_triggers: The deck's media, investment, and forecast claims are accompanied by dated, independently verifiable measures; even then, these would be context, not sufficient significance evidence by themselves.
Independent, replicated evidence demonstrates major performance or accessibility improvement against relevant alternatives and measurable outcomes across multiple sectors.
A credible barrier statement, positive suppression-test evidence, and demonstrated dissolution across at least two course-defined human-life tiers become available.
Evidence of durable dependencies and disruption if systems are removed would bear on irreversibility; evidence of easy substitution or return to prior processes would weigh against it.
A specific proposed enterprise application is defined with system boundaries, permissions, evaluation results, affected stakeholders, and unit-level risk conditions.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: The advocacy deck offers no sources or metrics, and the enterprise application is unspecified; neither supports a case-specific value or readiness conclusion.
Do not infer agent-specific outcomes from AI-wide survey results, investment, publicity, or vendor predictions.

Do not use Potentially Promethean unless the course-method gates and explicitly proposed threshold are supported; no prospectively assessed system can be called confirmed Promethean under this framework.
